body:
## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

Carry the laptop's local preset draft and whole-editor Save/Cancel journey into the production watch application, including usable native text/numeric input, removed preset Clear controls, durable save retry and stale-operation protection. Reproduce the laptop editor scenarios through actual watch main/touch/render/native Storage execution offline.

Use #43, the agreed domain glossary, ADR 0002 and the confirmed interaction specification. Fresh wheel seeding, editor command/confirmation and immediate per-field saving from #42 are superseded. The subsequent watch navigation slice adds revised swipe routing and wrapping; this ticket completes the native Save/Cancel journey through field controls.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Open each saved preset immediately from local configuration with no connection, scan, read wait or settings frame. Preserve existing awake/recovery rules. Session changes and external/corrupt/old-session readings cannot seed, alter, terminate or reset the local draft/input. Editing stays available without a wheel; any existing replay context remains unable to emit controls.
- [ ] Native name and numeric input edits only the transient draft. Retain entered text between fields, including unfinished input. Dip value remains saved/editable independently of inclusion; toggling inclusion is part of the same draft transaction, never a read or write of wheel settings.
- [ ] Save from every page or active keypad gathers all fields including latest input, validates 1–24 readable name characters with non-whitespace content and whole percentages 0–100 including omitted dip, and commits one selected-slot replacement through native Storage. Expose the new configuration/revision and return to preset selection only after successful staging/activation verification. Preserve the other three slots and current alert preferences.
- [ ] Cancel from any page/input discards the entire draft and returns to preset selection without a saved-value/revision change. Render Save and Cancel as the editor completion actions. Remove preset-list/editor Clear targets/dialogs, editor Back, Save slot and Set/Done; preserve input clearing/backspace/case/spaces/digits. All input, validation feedback and save failures remain usable within 240×240.
- [ ] Invalid Save identifies the field and retains all draft/input state. Failed/refused staging or active replacement keeps the previous active configuration and the open draft for local retry. Retry commits the complete draft once without a wheel operation. Interrupted writes retain validated previous-good recovery, including migrated and first-save/default cases.
- [ ] Successful completion retires the editor operation. Duplicate/late completion cannot persist it again. Configuration reload/replacement requires a fresh editor operation rather than letting an old draft silently overwrite newer content. Restart/compatible startup restores saved definitions only, without draft/page/input, commands or confirmation.
- [ ] Remove/retire editor-specific wheel-writing routes and stale per-field/preset-clear action targets. Every editor action emits zero wheel-setting packets and no wheel-confirmed result. A successful saved revision still invalidates pending/currently confirmed riding-preset requests and stops unsent continuation using the existing rules.
- [ ] The riding preset menu continues one-tap immediate application of only saved included fields. Preserve current session/revision eligibility, operation serialization, deadlines and visible outcomes. Independent alert editing, dashboard, horn/button, wake-only sleeping button cycles, prolonged-hold recovery and native module/bundle compatibility remain intact.

## Tests and evidence

- Replay the laptop local-editor ticket's reusable actions/raw frames with the watch public action/notification/view/command-output boundary and independent expected saved values. No private helper test suite or mocked application modules substitutes for integration.
- Exercise actual production main, native touch decoding/targets, Graphics, parser, GATT transport and native Storage in the existing offline harness. Enter/rename/edit all four slots on-screen, Save directly from active name/numeric input, Cancel multi-field edits, toggle omitted dip, and observe exact rendered destinations, packets and Storage effects.
- Assert zero setting packets through open/input/navigation/inclusion/Save/invalid Save/failed Save/retry/Cancel. Feed external settings and disconnect/reconnect while a draft is open and prove values/input remain unchanged. Separately apply a saved preset from the riding menu and confirm drafts never leak into its request.
- Inject staging refusal, partial active writes, failed first save and recovery from a sole valid legacy backup; validate active state while running and recovered state after restart. Cover duplicate/delayed completion, configuration reload during editing, preservation of other slots/alerts and revision invalidation during a pending preset operation.
- Update obsolete wheel-editor expectations in focused core/runtime/storage/control checks. Retain matching expected/observed actions, renderings, packets, Storage writes, source versions/hashes and simulated-hardware labels. Physical flash guarantees, display/input/vibration, memory fit, live controls and deployment remain separately unverified.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/45 — supplies native versioned configuration, dip semantics and migration/recovery support.
- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/46 — supplies the completed local editor interaction and reusable public-action/UI scenarios to reproduce on the watch.
title: Make watch preset editing local with whole-editor Save and Cancel
